qi_unleashed.text_zh: 连击——若卧虎是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+4力量。
qi_unleashed.text_en: Combo - If Crouching Tiger was the last attack this combat chain, this gets +4{p}.

quantum_processor.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
每回合一次瞬间——费用0：将你手牌中一张费用为0或1的机械师物品放入竞技场。
quantum_processor.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with a steam counter. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Once per Turn Instant - 0: Put a Mechanologist item with cost 0 or 1 from your hand into the arena.

quartermasters_boots.text_zh:
行动——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：你本回合使用的下一张非攻击行动牌获得再动。再动
刃碎
quartermasters_boots.text_en:
Action - {r}{r}, destroy this: The next non-attack action card you play this turn gets go again. Go again
Blade Break

quick_clicks.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：你本回合的下一次攻击获得再动。仅当本回合你使用过一张轻灵之道时才能启动此异能。再动
quick_clicks.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Your next attack this turn gets go again. Activate this only if you've played a Nimblism this turn. Go again

quick_succession.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动
quick_succession.text_zh:
本回合你使用的下一张符文剑士或闪电攻击行动牌获得再动。
本回合你的接下来3次攻击在具有再动期间获得+1力量。
再动
quick_succession.text_en:
The next Runeblade or Lightning attack action card you play this turn gets go again.
Your next 3 attacks this turn get +1{p} while they have go again.
Go again

quickdodge_flexors.text_zh:
防御反应——支付1点资源：将此牌作为防御牌加入当前链环。此链环中它有2点基础防御。
在结束阶段开始时，若此牌本回合进行过防御，摧毁它。
quickdodge_flexors.text_en:
Defense Reaction - {r}: Add this to the active chain link as a defending card. It has 2 base {d} this chain link.
At the beginning of the end phase, if this defendend this turn, destroy it.

quicken.text_zh: 当你使用攻击行动牌或启动武器攻击时，摧毁此牌，该攻击获得再动。
quicken.text_en: When you play an attack action card or activate a weapon attack, destroy this and the attack gains go again.

quickening_sand.text_zh:
在目标英雄的控制下创造一个加速衍生物。
再动
当此牌防御具有再动的攻击时，横置目标英雄或盟友。
quickening_sand.text_en:
Create a Quicken token under target hero's control.
Go again
When this defends an attack with go again, {t} target hero or ally.

quickfire.text_zh:
每当你控制一张超频驱动器，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
本回合你推进的下一次攻击获得+4力量。
再动
quickfire.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Hyper Driver you control.
The next attack you boost this turn gets +4{p}.
Go again

quicksilver_dagger.type_zh: 战士 武器·匕首 （单手）
quicksilver_dagger.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
若本回合你控制的另一把武器获得过再动，此牌的攻击获得再动。
quicksilver_dagger.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
If another weapon you control has gained go again this turn, this card's attacks get go again.

quicksilver_dance.text_zh: 从目标攻击中的武器上移除一个+1力量指示物。若如此做，创造一个剑舞衍生物并抽一张牌。
quicksilver_dance.text_en: Remove a +1{p} counter from target attacking weapon. If you do, create a Blade Dance token and draw a card.

quickstep.text_zh: 行动——摧毁此牌：每位英雄创造一个加速衍生物。再动
quickstep.text_en: Action - Destroy this: Each hero creates a Quicken token.  Go again

quiver_of_abyssal_depths.text_zh: 瞬间——支付3点资源，摧毁深渊之底箭袋：将你坟场中至多3张不同名称的箭矢洗入你的牌库。
quiver_of_abyssal_depths.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}{r}, destroy Quiver of Abyssal Depths: Shuffle up to 3 arrows with different names from your graveyard into your deck.

quiver_of_rustling_leaves.text_zh: 瞬间——支付3点资源：展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为箭矢，将其正面朝上放入你的军械库并摧毁沙沙叶响箭袋。
quiver_of_rustling_leaves.text_en: Instant - {r}{r}{r}: Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's an arrow, put it face up into your arsenal and destroy Quiver of Rustling Leaves.
